Concrete subclass for SUSHI RNA-seq SummarizedExperiment outputs

Source: R/ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq.R
ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq.Rd

Reads from a SUSHI ezApp DESeq2 / edgeR / limma result. Top-level rowData(se) carries feature annotations plus inline DE columns for the single contrast described by param$comparison. Optional pre-computed enrichResult / gseaResult objects live in metadata(se).

Value

An R6 class generator; $new() returns an ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq object.

Details

Inherits the accessor contract from ExploreDataset via ExploreDatasetSE; overrides only .build_config() and .prep().

Super classes

ExploreDataset -> ExploreDatasetSE -> ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq

ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq$clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

deep

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

se <- readRDS(system.file("examples/genomics/deResult.rds", package = "exploreDE"))
eds <- ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq$new(se)
eds
#> <ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq  (se)>
#>   data_type:        RNASeq
#>   feature_id_kind:  gene
#>   organism:         Homo sapiens
#>   ref_build:        Homo_sapiens/GENCODE/GRCh38.p13/Annotation/Release_42-2023-01-30
#>   samples x features: 9 x 21057
#>   factors (1):
#>     Condition  (primary): diff, undiff
#>   contrasts (1): diff_vs_undiff
#>   primary_contrast: diff_vs_undiff
#>   assays:           counts, normalised, normalised_log2, vst, fpkm, tpm
#>   enrichment:       ora, gsea
eds$contrasts()
